"""Single-episode camera-guided Panda controller; no simulator state access."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
LIMITS = np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])
ORIGINS = [([0,0,.333],0),([0,0,0],-np.pi/2),([0,-.316,0],np.pi/2),([.0825,0,0],np.pi/2),([-.0825,.384,0],-np.pi/2),([0,0,0],np.pi/2),([.088,0,0],np.pi/2)]
DOWN = np.diag([1.,-1.,-1.])

def fk(q):
    t=np.eye(4)
    t[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',np.pi/2).as_matrix()
    t[:3,3]=[0,-.4,.78]
    for theta,(xyz,rx) in zip(q,ORIGINS):
        o=np.eye(4);o[:3,3]=xyz;o[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('x',rx).as_matrix()
        z=np.eye(4);z[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',theta).as_matrix()
        t=t@o@z
    f=np.eye(4);f[:3,3]=[0,0,.2];f[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',-np.pi/4).as_matrix()
    return t@f

def ik(pos, rot, seed):
    def error(q):
        t=fk(q)
        return np.r_[4*(t[:3,3]-pos),Rotation.from_matrix(rot@t[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec(),.008*(q-seed)]
    res=least_squares(error,np.clip(seed,LIMITS[:,0]+1e-5,LIMITS[:,1]-1e-5),bounds=(LIMITS[:,0]+1e-5,LIMITS[:,1]-1e-5),max_nfev=250)
    t=fk(res.x)
    err=np.linalg.norm(t[:3,3]-pos)
    if err>.008: raise ValueError(f'Unreachable position {pos}; residual {err}')
    return res.x

def observe(name='obs', depth=True):
    result=r.get_obs(include_depth=depth,video='none')
    result.save(OUT/name)
    return result

def state():
    return np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'])

def submit_rows(rows,name):
    rows=np.asarray(rows)
    entry={'name':name,'actions':rows.tolist(),'dt':.1}
    with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(entry)+'\n')
    result=r.submit('joint_position',rows,dt=.1,cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'],video='none',include_depth=True,note=name)
    result.save(OUT/name)
    print(json.dumps(result.meta))
    return result

def move(pos, fingers=.04, duration=3., rot=DOWN, name='move'):
    now=state();q0=now[:7];p0=now[16:19]
    r0=Rotation.from_quat(now[[20,21,22,19]]).as_matrix()
    delta=Rotation.from_matrix(rot@r0.T).as_rotvec()
    q=q0.copy();rows=[]
    for i in range(1,round(duration/.1)+1):
        s=i/round(duration/.1);s=s*s*(3-2*s)
        ri=Rotation.from_rotvec(s*delta).as_matrix()@r0
        q=ik((1-s)*p0+s*np.array(pos),ri,q)
        rows.append(np.r_[q,(1-s)*now[14:16]+s*fingers])
    rows.extend([rows[-1]]*10)
    if len(rows)>100:raise ValueError('chunk too long')
    return submit_rows(rows,name)

def grip(fingers, duration=1.5, name='grip'):
    now=state();rows=[]
    for i in range(1,round(duration/.1)+1):
        s=i/round(duration/.1)
        rows.append(np.r_[now[:7],(1-s)*now[14:16]+s*fingers])
    rows.extend([rows[-1]]*10)
    return submit_rows(rows,name)

def pixel_world(cam,u,v,path):
    d=np.load(OUT/path/f'depth_{cam}.npy')[-1];z=float(d[v,u]);c=spec['cameras'][cam]
    k=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);t=np.array(c['cam2world_gl'])
    return t[:3,:3]@np.array([(u-k[0,2])*z/k[0,0],-(v-k[1,2])*z/k[1,1],-z])+t[:3,3]

if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('action',choices=['observe','move','grip','status'])
    parser.add_argument('--pos',type=float,nargs=3)
    parser.add_argument('--fingers',type=float,default=.04)
    parser.add_argument('--duration',type=float,default=3.)
    parser.add_argument('--name',default='obs')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
    if args.action=='observe': print(json.dumps(observe(args.name).meta))
    elif args.action=='move':move(args.pos,args.fingers,args.duration,name=args.name)
    elif args.action=='grip':grip(args.fingers,args.duration,args.name)
    else:print(r.status())
